title: What the Shoebill waits for

is_this_you.pressure: Under pressure you go still. Whoever is pushing runs out of things to say first.
is_this_you.love: You greet the one you chose with a sound that would scare off anyone else.
is_this_you.cost: You can wait so well that the waiting becomes the plan, and the moment goes by while you check it.

opener.text: Abu markub. In Arabic it means father of the shoe [s10]. Someone looked at that bill and gave up on dignity. Science went the other way and named it Balaeniceps rex, the whale-headed king [s10] [s7]. Both names stuck. You have been called plain and you have been called royal. You did not move for either.

howto: Three parts. Take them slowly. Nothing here is going anywhere.

tabs.label: Stillness
tabs.intro: Earth on Earth. Nothing inside you pushes back.

rows.text: Capricorn is cardinal Earth, ruled by Saturn [s1]. The Ox is yin Earth, very patient and careful with a plan [s3] [s4]. The same element, twice. Nothing in you hurries you. Nothing talks you out of a decision once it is made.

It hunts by standing over shallow water until a lungfish or catfish comes up [s8] [s7]. It favours water poor in oxygen, where fish have to surface more often [s8] [s7]. Then it waits. You pick your ground like that. You stand where the thing you want will run short of air.

tabs.label: The long wait
tabs.intro: One strike. Then you find your feet again.

rows.text: When it strikes, it throws head and neck forward so hard it loses its balance [s8]. It cannot strike again straight away [s8]. So it does not strike at shadows. Neither do you. You get one good move a season, and you spend it on a sure thing.

The Ox guides list engineering, real estate and agriculture [s4]. Long builds suit you. An old oath ritual gave Chinese the phrase 执牛耳 (zhí niú ěr), to hold the ox's ear, which now means to lead [s6]. You get that grip by staying longest.
You buy ground and keep it. The risk is holding on after it stopped paying.

tabs.label: Who shares your marsh
tabs.intro: Few get this close. These three can.
tabs.love_lead: At the nest, mates greet each other by clattering their bills [s8] [s7]. To a stranger it sounds like a threat. To the one you chose it has meant hello since the first season. Capricorn opens slowly [s2], and the Ox values friendships that last [s4]. The old pairings name three who can stand that near.

easy.why: The Weaverbird (Virgo, Rooster year) shares your trine of Ox, Snake and Rooster, and Virgo is Earth like you [s5] [s1].
The Aardwolf (Taurus, Rat year) is your secret friend, since the Rat is the Ox's hidden ally, and Taurus is the third Earth sign [s5] [s1].
The Slow Loris (Scorpio, Snake year) is trine kin, with Scorpio's Water to soak into your dry ground [s5] [s1].

hard.why: The hard one is the Glasswing Butterfly (Cancer, Goat year): the Goat clashes with the Ox, and Cancer sits opposite Capricorn [s5] [s1].

story.text: Yu the Great was said to throw iron oxen into rivers and lakes to hold back the floods [s6]. The custom became iron ox statues set beside the water as guardians [s6]. An iron ox has one job. It stands at the edge and lets the water try.

closing: Hold still. What you waited for is coming up for air, right in front of you.
